title: Fugacity-concentration relationship of dilute hydrogen in water at elevated temperature and pressure
experimental_method: Equilibrium H2 concentration in water measured in hydrothermal vessels in contact with a magnetite-hematite buffer (300-500 C) and a palladium hydride buffer (150 and 205.5 C), sampling the aqueous phase; fugacity of H2 fixed by the buffer, Y = fH2/C_H2 then calculated.
uncertainties_stated: Duplicate C_H2 determinations agree within 0.7 per cent (PHW system); smoothed Y values of Table 4 expected accurate within 5 per cent.
quality_remarks: Y values depend on buffer fugacity scales (Pd hydride desorption plateau; authors' own MH fO2 scale, eq. 9) and are anchored to literature H2 solubility at the saturation vapour pressure; the primary measured quantity is C_H2. Temperature scale not stated. Pure-water systems only (NaCl solutions deferred to another paper).
